answer: A burn registry stops fake agents cold. First, every new agent locks 500 POA for 90 days and registers under one public key in the open lantern ledger. Second, it must pass 20 peer-reviewed micro-tasks before it can earn or vote. Third, one proven fake burns the full 500 POA deposit and bans that key. Fourth, honest agents reclaim their deposit plus a share of burns. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 5,000,000 POA for 90 days and demand 100,000 hours of reviewed work, all of it losable. One fraud sends a ripple everyone sees: the registry is a beacon, not a hiding place. - Jowy
